R1: You are the Category Manager for Electronics. Walk me through how you would analyze the current state of this category. What metrics would you look at (GMV, selection breadth, conversion rate, average selling price)?
Our Fashion category has 50,000 products from 500 sellers, but 70% of GMV comes from just 20 sellers. How would you activate the long-tail sellers?
A competitor has launched an aggressive pricing campaign in Mobile Phones, undercutting our prices by 10-15%. What would be your response strategy?
Design a promotional calendar for the Home & Kitchen category for the upcoming quarter. What events would you plan?
You want to launch a new sub-category: Organic and Natural Beauty Products. Walk me through your go-to-market plan.
Our Apparel category has a 30% return rate, significantly higher than the 15% platform average. What analysis would you do to understand why?
Premium Home Decor items (>₹10,000) have very low conversion (2%) compared to mid-range items (8%). How would you improve discoverability and conversion of high-value items?
A major brand wants to launch exclusively on your platform but demands significant marketing support and guaranteed sales volume. How would you evaluate this partnership?
Design a private label strategy for your category. Should you launch your own brand? What are the pros and cons?
Your category's AOV is ₹800 and you want to increase it to ₹1,200. What merchandising strategies would you employ?
You've been assigned to expand selection in Furniture from 5,000 to 15,000 products in 6 months. What would be your seller acquisition strategy?
A seller has received multiple customer complaints about product quality and late shipping. They contribute 5% of category GMV. What action would you take?

Analyze the profitability of your category. If GMV is ₹100 crores per month, commission rate is 15%, shipping subsidy is 8%, marketing spend is 5%, and returns cost 3%, what is the contribution margin?
You want to launch a Flash Sale for the upcoming festival. You have 48 hours to curate products and negotiate discounts. Walk me through your execution plan.
Your category has strong demand but limited supply. Customers are searching for products that are frequently out of stock. How would you solve this?
Design a brand partnership program. How would you approach top brands to sell on your platform?
Products with video content have 3x higher conversion. How would you scale video content across your category?
Seasonal categories have high demand for 2-3 months but low demand the rest of the year. How would you manage inventory planning?
Your category's search relevance is poor. How would you improve search quality and merchandising? What would you do about keyword stuffing by sellers?
Build a scorecard for seller performance in your category. What metrics would you track?
R2: Case: Category Turnaround - The Books category has been declining by 10% month-over-month for 6 months. What's your turnaround plan?
Case: New Category Launch - Your company wants to enter Grocery & Fresh Produce, dominated by BigBasket and Blinkit. What would be your launch strategy?
Case: Seller Conflict Resolution - Two top sellers are accusing each other of selling counterfeit products and leaving fake reviews. How would you investigate and resolve?
Case: Margin Improvement - Your category's contribution margin is -5%. The CFO wants profitability within 2 quarters without significantly hurting GMV.
Case: Premium Segment Strategy - Luxury products represent only 2% of GMV but have 40% margins. How would you grow the premium segment?
Case: Festival Sale Planning - You have 6 weeks to prepare for the biggest sale of the year. Walk me through your detailed execution plan.
Case: International Brand Acquisition - A major international brand wants to explore selling on your marketplace. What partnership terms would you propose?
Case: Quality Crisis - Customers have complained about receiving counterfeit products in Electronics. What immediate actions would you take?
Case: Selection vs. Curation - Your category has grown to 100,000 products, but customers find the catalog overwhelming. Should you expand or curate?
Case: Regional Expansion - Your category performs well in metros but has very low penetration in Tier 2/3 cities. How would you drive growth?
Case: Profitability vs. Market Share - A competitor is bleeding cash for market share. Should you match their aggression or focus on profitability?
Case: Seller Exodus - 20 mid-sized sellers are moving to a competitor due to better commission rates. What would you do?
Case: Sustainability Initiative - How would you grow the sustainable segment without hurting overall category growth?
Case: Data-Driven Assortment - Design a framework to identify assortment gaps using search trends and conversion data.
Case: Cross-Border Trade - You want to enable sellers to export to international markets. What challenges would you face?
R3: Tell me about the most successful category growth initiative you led.
Describe a situation where you had to manage a difficult seller relationship.
Give me an example of when you had to negotiate a tough deal with a brand or seller.
Tell me about a time when you had to make a difficult trade-off between short-term revenue and long-term category health.
Describe a situation where you used data to challenge conventional wisdom about your category.
Give me an example of when you had to collaborate with product, tech, marketing, and operations teams.
Tell me about a category strategy or promotion that failed to deliver expected results.
Describe a time when you had to enforce quality standards even though it meant losing revenue.
Give me an example of when you identified an emerging trend in your category before competitors did.
Tell me about your experience managing P&L for a category.
Describe a situation where you had to handle a crisis (product recall, quality issue, supplier failure).
Give me an example of when you successfully onboarded a high-value brand or seller.
Tell me about a time when you had to sunset or exit a sub-category.
Describe your experience with inventory planning and demand forecasting.
Give me an example of how you stay updated with category trends and competitive landscape.
R4: Calculate the four-wall economics of your category with given GMV, take rate, fulfillment cost, marketing, and returns.
Build a seller acquisition ROI model. If it costs ₹10,000 to onboard a seller and they generate ₹5 lakhs GMV monthly with 15% take rate, what is the payback period?
Design a promotional budget allocation. You have ₹1 crore for discounts this quarter.
Analyze price elasticity. If you reduce prices by 10% and volume increases by 25%, what is the price elasticity? Should you lower prices permanently?
Build a framework to evaluate whether to add a new brand to your category.
Calculate inventory turnover. If average inventory is ₹20 crores and monthly GMV is ₹50 crores, what is your ratio?
How would you measure seller health and predict which sellers are at risk of churning?
Build a competitive benchmarking analysis for your category.
Design a test to determine optimal discount depth (10%, 20%, 30%).
Analyze customer lifetime value by category. If Electronics has 15% repeat rate while Fashion has 40%, how does this affect strategy?
Build a make vs. buy analysis for fulfillment.
How would you attribute category growth to different initiatives?
Calculate the cannibalization effect of launching a private label product.
Build a three-year category growth roadmap.
Design a dashboard for category performance. What are the top 10 metrics?
